Runs in the background; you don\'t need to keep this app open

This app adjusts screen orientation through LSPosed, which counts as an unofficial modification: it doesn\'t modify system files, and the core features don\'t need root — but please understand the risks before using it. If something goes wrong, just disable the module in LSPosed to restore everything.

“Attention detection / Smart scanning” holds the front camera, so the orientation occasionally lags — consider turning it off: Settings → Lock screen → Attention detection.\n\nDon\'t swipe this app away from Recents: that lets the system camera take the front camera and adaptive mode stops working.

The button only appears when the phone\'s orientation differs from the screen\'s. Tapping here makes it pop up once right away (same place as usual, bottom-right); if nothing happens, check the Diagnostics page.
If the screen rotates the wrong way, calibrate with the two steps below.
① is done — now do ②.
Calibrated. Redo it if the orientation goes wrong again.
① Hold the phone upright facing you, head straight, for 2 seconds
② Turn the phone to landscape with the camera on the left, head still upright, for 2 seconds
